$comment: EPIC-031 T734. The initial risk-classification steering document: load into a workspace's steering (subject risk-classification). It declares only what is high under every tenant policy (FR-DPE-012). Everything else is unmatched and therefore high too (FR-DPE-004) until a tenant writes a rule lowering it — authoring a low band means auto-executing an action without a human, which is a tenant's decision, not a shipped default.
